additional_concerns: Retention of ultimate responsibility, supervisory conduct and operational outcomes are distinct. The source supplies no necessary-and-sufficient test for effective retention or discharge through supervision. Governance and practical authority may be evidence, but cannot become mandatory criteria without further support.
Outsourcing is not an exception to responsibility. The duty also applies without outsourcing; the outsourcing condition in the scoped claim must not narrow the general duty.

Paragraph 14 attaches the request language expressly to demonstration, while confirmation is stated separately. Footnote 5 may elaborate that request-conditioned demonstration or independently express an unqualified expectation. Neither reading establishes retained accountability merely from confirmation or demonstration.

Paragraphs 15 and 16 separately require third-party audit or verification and a satisfactory legal opinion upon request. Absence of a request does not remove substantive responsibility; obtaining either document does not establish substantive fulfillment.

The register-maintenance provisions permit the specified scheme, trustee or appointee to maintain the register without displacing the Product Provider's ultimate responsibility. The intermediary issuance provision likewise preserves responsibility within its own actor and activity scope.
No actual arrangement facts or executable expressions are supplied. Retrieval results establish location only, and the unsupported structural check establishes no legal or executable fidelity.
